JUDGMENT

This is a charge sheet filed by the P.S.I of Banaswadi Police Station against the accused for the offences punishable U/sec. 63 of Copy Right Act and 420 of IPC.
02.

The brief facts of the prosecution case is that, on 15.07.2016 at about 04.30 p.m., within the limits of Banaswadi Police Station at Trendi Fashions, No.4, Kammanahalli, 2nd Cross, Old Neelgiries Road, Bengaluru, CW.1 got information that, the accused was selling spurious /
counterfeit garments i.e., jeans pants of reputed company i.e., MUFTI of CW.1 without having any authorization or written consent from the Copyright Holder and cheated the company and public and thus the accused has C.C.No.6388/2021 committed the offences punishable U/sec.63 of Copy Right Act and 420 of IPC.
03.
After filing of charge sheet, this court took cognizance for the offences punishable U/sec. 63 of Copy Right Act and 420 of IPC and issued summons to the accused.
Accordingly the accused appeared before the court through his counsel and enlarged on bail.

The charge sheet copy and other prosecution papers were furnished to the accused by complying the provisions of Sec.207 of Cr.P.C.
04.
Heard both side on framing of charge, perused the prosecution papers.
As there are sufficient materials to frame the charge against the accused, the charges has been framed and the same were read over to him, but he pleaded not guilty and claimed for trial.
Hence the case was posted for prosecution evidence.

05. The prosecution in order to prove its case has not examined any of the witnesses, in spite of repeated issuance of NBW and proclamation against CW.1 to 10 the concerned agency failed to execute the same to the said witnesses and bring them before this court, hence prayer of learned Sr.APP is rejected.
CW.1 to 10 are C.C.No.6388/2021 dropped and closed the side of the prosecution evidence, as there is no incriminating circumstances against the accused.

Hence, the accused statement U/Sec.313 of Cr.P.C. is dispensed with and posted for judgment.
06.
In order to prove the guilt of the offence as alleged against the accused persons by the prosecution, the prosecution has not at all examined any one of the witnesses.
It is relevant to note that, the prosecution has cited 10 witnesses.

In spite of issuance of summons warrant against the CW.1 to 10, the prosecution has utterly failed to secure the presence of CW.1 to 10 though this Court issued coercive process of witness warrant against CW.1 to 10, they have not appeared before the court.
Therefore, this Court dropped out CW.1 to 10.
Therefore, this Court proceed in accordance with law.
Hence, prosecution has utterly failed to prove the guilt of the offence as alleged against the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Thereby the accused is entitled for the benefit of doubt.
